integrity: Analytical infinite-dimensional proof supplied, with optional numerical replication, and no claim of external verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact constants and one-sided expansion are for first-band reproduction through degree one with output through degree two; stability is restricted to equivariant multipliers; non-equivariant optimizer uniqueness, larger bandwidths and dimension-uniform rates are not established. Prior historical equivalence remains a possible risk.
title: Exact first-transition-band spherical Fourier norm and a dimension-dependent stability cusp
